# Frozen 2026-11-05 at Phase 3 entry, steps 2-3 (#6603, rev 20). Baselines are
# docs/audits/MLIGHT_phase3_entry_41b74db49.tsv (A3, A5 and the local-light A4
# rung) and docs/audits/MLIGHT_phase3_shd007_A2A4_sun.tsv (the sun-rung A4,
# re-measured after RLT-SHD-007 narrowed the sun cone from 61 to 14 px).
# Owner decisions (2026-11-05):
# note A4: band budgets are 5e-4 mean / 2e-3 p95 of the unoccluded luminance, a visibility
#   argument: one 8-bit step is about 1.7 % at mid-grey and 3 % in shadow, so the p95 budget is
#   about an eighth of a step at mid-grey and the mean budget less. Strictly below the sun-rung baselines (mean
#   6.5e-4 / 1.1e-3, p95 3.4e-3 / 4.1e-3). Local-light umbra is already ~0 and is held.
# note A5: the 2 cm plank takes a budget (mean 2e-3 / p95 1e-2, about half its baseline);
#   block, cube, panel and the skinned proxy are declared done. The plank is as large with the
#   filter off (4.0e-3 / 2.1e-2), so the filter is not its cause.
# note T: temporal metrics are the excess of the moving capture's temporal error over the
#   hold-from-frame-0 control (--bench-camera-hold-at); frozen_floor is that control's own
#   value (cold start + sampling noise) at the worst frame. A3: the maximum over frames
#   32-112 and the value 16 frames after the stop (settled within 1 % RMSE, about a quarter
#   second). A14: frames before 80 carry the run's cold start and are reported, not gated.
#   An excess metric's threshold is its budget (the floor is already subtracted). The excess's own seed-pair noise is not yet measured; the 2x-floor drift margin is
#   carried over from rev 13 and is provisional for these rows.
# Not decided (report-only until the owner writes them): A2 penumbra width, A4 thin-rod
#   shadow (mean 8.7e-3 / p95 2.3e-2), and the A14 frames before 80.
# Revised 2026-11-06 (rev 28, #6721). RLT-SHD-012 made the traced visibility match the
# reference, so the rows frozen against the old, biased sampler were re-measured at tier 3
# (docs/audits/MLIGHT_phase3_shd012_gates.tsv) and these rows re-frozen: A4 local-light
# umbra p95 and lit p95 (floors 0 and 8.8e-12 drifted: the filter's seed noise changed, the
# values are 2.4e-4 and 1.4e-3); A4 lit-band mean on both rungs, budget 5e-4 -> 1e-3 (values
# 9.2e-4 local, 7.7e-4 sun: the filter's own lit-side bleed, 5 % of one 8-bit step at
# mid-grey, the same 8.9e-4 the fixed-reach filter showed at Phase 3 entry; the 4.3e-4 of rev
# 22 was measured against a sampler that read the penumbra interior 0.2-0.4 % dark); A5
# block, cube and panel p95 re-baselined by the done-row rule (threshold = frozen floor +
# accepted baseline). The A5 references are now rendered at 16 x the A2 / A4 sample count:
# the plank passes its unchanged budget (mean 1.6e-3, p95 6.5e-3).
